intentProfile.routingReason: LOGO brand sheet needs precise editable vector geometry (SVG) + exact wordmark text; not bitmap-first.

project.styleDefinitionBrief: 山野摄影陪伴品牌'栖光 LumaNest'的 LOGO 品牌稿：山脊绿 + 日橙 + 暖纸的克制自然主义，极简几何，可缩放矢量，编辑设计感。
project.designRead: brand-sheet / brand-internal / 自然克制 / 中密度 / 避免装饰性渐变与emoji图标

palette.sun: #D77A45 (日橙 sun — 光/light, core logo identity color)

typographySystem.cjkDisplay: Zcool XiaoWei / Noto Serif SC (品牌字, 用于'栖光'字标)
typographySystem.latinDisplay: Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display (LumaNest 拉丁字标)

shapeSystem.note: LOGO本身的圆角与几何需精确，不滥用大圆角

styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceDepthModel: border-led, static shadow alpha <= 0.05; brand sheet是平面印刷质感，避免浮起阴影

pagePlan.title: 栖光 LOGO 品牌稿
pagePlan.requirements: Single-page brand sheet showcasing the LumaNest logo. Inline SVG logo with precise vector geometry. Sections: (1) Hero — primary logo lockup (symbol + 栖光 wordmark + LumaNest latin) on warm paper; (2) Symbol — the mark alone large with construction grid (circles, golden ratio, clear-space margins); (3) Variations — full-color / monochrome ink / reversed-on-ridge-green / reversed-on-night / app-icon application (rounded square); (4) Wordmark lockups — horizontal + stacked; (5) Color palette swatches with hex; (6) Clear space & minimum size rules. All logo artwork must be inline SVG with exact geometry — NO raster images, NO emoji. Use brand tokens from colors_and_type.css.
